verdict.rationale: The evidence offers no cloud-side region or residency selector, but it does support self-hosting. The Apache-2.0 LiveKit server boots locally with no account (probe-rt-2), self-hosting deployment docs exist, and the agents framework is pip-installable, so users can control where data lives by running their own infrastructure. Model plugins also let you override the provider base URL. This delivers data placement only through the self-hosting workaround, not as a choosable residency option. missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection on LiveKit Cloud, explicit residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration of data-location controls.
